content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail: Start digital

The key to success lies in leveraging a sovereign digital commerce stack, which gives you full control over your store and payments. By using GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, and NOWPayments for crypto payments, you can create a seamless and secure payment and delivery pipeline. This infrastructure is not only cost-effective but also scalable, allowing you to focus on what matters most - creating and selling your digital products.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before you deploy your sovereign digital commerce stack, you need to have a clear understanding of your products, pricing, and target audience. You should also have a basic understanding of crypto payments and how they work. Additionally, you'll need to set up a digital wallet and obtain a crypto payment gateway API key from NOWPayments. With these essentials in place, you can start building your store and configuring your payment and delivery pipeline.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Setting up your payment and delivery pipeline is a straightforward process. You'll need to configure your crypto payment gateway, set up your digital product storage, and integrate your payment and delivery systems. With NOWPayments, you can accept over 300 cryptocurrencies and benefit from a low 0.5% transaction fee. You can also use Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to automate your product delivery, ensuring that your customers receive their purchases instantly.
Retain $921 in fees at 100 sales per month on a $97 product with NOWPayments.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once you've set up your payment and delivery pipeline, you can go live and start processing transactions. You'll need to test your store and payment system to ensure that everything is working smoothly. With the Complete Builder Kit, you can get instant access to all the tools and templates you need to build, deploy, and scale your sovereign digital commerce stack. You can also refer to the shop URL at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html for more information and support.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

As your store grows and you start to process more transactions, you'll need to scale your infrastructure to meet the demand. This can be done by upgrading your hosting, adding more payment gateways, and optimizing your delivery pipeline. With the right infrastructure in place, you can focus on creating and selling more digital products, knowing that your store can handle the increased traffic and sales. By retaining $921 in fees at 100 sales per month on a $97 product, you can reinvest that money into growing your business and increasing your revenue.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

To sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe, you can use a sovereign digital commerce stack that leverages crypto payments. With NOWPayments, you can accept over 300 cryptocurrencies and benefit from a low 0.5% transaction fee, which is significantly lower than the 10% fee charged by Gumroad. This means that at 100 sales per month on a $97 product, you can retain $921 in fees, which can be reinvested into growing your business.

To deploy your sovereign digital commerce stack, follow these steps: set up your digital wallet and obtain a crypto payment gateway API key from NOWPayments, configure your crypto payment gateway, set up your digital product storage, integrate your payment and delivery systems, test your store and payment system, and go live. You can also use the Complete Builder Kit to get instant access to all the tools and templates you need to build, deploy, and scale your sovereign digital commerce stack.
